manual_runtime_test_caveat: The recorded starter and reference outcomes cover this Pack's own behavioral contracts. The upstream project's full test suite was not run and is not claimed by this receipt.
reason: Every behavioral contract fails on 2.6 and passes on 2.9.1; both endpoints pass the agent-visible source smoke.
shortfall_reason: The 2.6 -> 2.9.1 window contains 17 candidate changes and only 13 of them carry a behavior difference that a public-API contract can observe, so the Pack ships 13 contracts (9 public + 4 heldout) instead of 16. The four held-out demands were kept at full strength because they carry the transfer measurement; the shortfall was taken entirely on the public side, which drops from 12 to 9. Four candidates were rejected for having no observable behavior difference at all (annotation-only typing changes, test-only accommodation for a stdlib parser change, the lazy-pattern-construction refactor and its two follow-ups, and two Python-version support-matrix changes). No demand was invented and no contract was weakened to reach a count.
